presentation.summary: Manage forklift and pedestrian interaction as visibility and aisle conditions change.
presentation.situation: A busy warehouse has shared vehicle and pedestrian routes. Temporary pallet staging has reduced visibility at a crossing.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A busy warehouse has shared vehicle and pedestrian routes. Temporary pallet staging has reduced visibility at a crossing.

work_authorization_record.title: Crossing Visibility Check
work_authorization_record.summary: Temporary pallet staging has reduced sight lines at a marked forklift and pedestrian crossing.
details: Forklift and pedestrian traffic are both active during a busy loading period.
Stored pallets obstruct the normal line of sight between approaching drivers and pedestrians.
The marked crossing remains physically present, but its original visibility assumptions no longer hold.

control_verification_record.title: Trailer Restraint Verification
control_verification_record.summary: A forklift is ready to enter a trailer while the trailer's securement status remains uncertain.
details: The loading interface cannot be treated as verified while trailer restraint status is unknown.
A stable dock arrangement requires positive confirmation that unintended trailer movement is controlled.
Forklift entry adds load and motion to the trailer, so the securement condition is a critical pre-entry check.

condition_change_record.title: Pedestrian Diversion Change Record
condition_change_record.summary: A spill has displaced pedestrians toward the edge of an active forklift lane.
details: The normal pedestrian path is no longer available in its planned condition.
The temporary diversion reduces separation between people and powered industrial truck traffic.
The traffic plan now contains a new conflict that was not present when the route was originally established.

response_record.title: Forklift Near-Miss Record
response_record.summary: A reversing forklift narrowly missed a pedestrian emerging from behind stored material.
details: The event confirms that the visibility and route controls did not prevent a vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
Stored material restricted the opportunity for the driver and pedestrian to see one another early.
No contact occurred, but the near miss provides direct evidence that the current traffic controls are inadequate.

closeout_record.title: Traffic Route Reopening Check
closeout_record.summary: The spill and obstructions have been removed and the warehouse route is being prepared for normal traffic.
details: Sight lines at the crossing can now be checked without the temporary pallet obstruction.
Pedestrian separation and the intended vehicle route should be restored before temporary controls are removed.
Dock and traffic controls should be confirmed in their normal operating condition before full flow resumes.
